title: SpeechNexusPublicErrors
description: Single source of truth for the OpenAI-compatible public error envelope shared by the speech, realtime, admin, and workbench public protocols. Internal control-plane errors add their own diagnostic fields instead of reusing this envelope.

retryable.description: Whether the same dispatch may be retried after the refusal. The value belongs to the refusing operation's disposition, not to the status or the code: one operation's 409 may ask the caller to wait out a cleanup (retryable) while another 409 in the same operation reports a spent idempotency key (not retryable), so a caller reads this field instead of inferring retryability from the status. It answers only that question, and only for a refusal. A 5xx states an unknown outcome rather than a refusal, so the original identity is replayed because the outcome is unknown, not because this field permits a retry: a 503 `outcome_unknown` is `retryable: false` and must still be replayed under the original Idempotency-Key. The meaning is per operation rather than global: workbench operations publish their disposition in `contracts/workbench-openapi.yaml`, while the speech Job operations compute this field from the narrower question 'may an unknown execution outcome be replayed?', which is why `execution_cleanup_pending` is `false` there although the correct action is to dispatch the same intent again under the same key; a consumer that must state one code's operator step reads that operation's published vocabulary instead of this field.

OperationRecovery.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.
